method: Exact named Google Maps campground points were matched to current federal facility records. Drive estimates use the no-ferry route from Seattle so planning times do not omit ferry queues or sailing time.

reviews.coordinate_source: Google Maps exact named campground point matched to the Forest Service facility address and directions
reviews.route_note: Uses the no-ferry I-5, Tacoma Narrows, and US 101 route; ferry routes may show less driving time but add fare, queue, and sailing uncertainty.
